question.text: In the context of the Hall-Heroult process for the extraction of <math> <mrow> <mtext>Al,</mtext></mrow> </math> which of the following statements is false ?

options.text: CO and  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>   are produced in this process

<math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is mixed with  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  which lowers the melting point of the mixture and brings conductivity
<math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math>  is reduced at the cathode to form Al

<math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub></math> helps in increasing the melting point of the mixture

solution.text:
Hall heroult process:
In the Hall-Héroult process the following simplified reactions take place at the carbon electrodes:
Cathode: Al3++3e-1→Al
Anode: O2-+C→CO+2e- 

Overall:
Al2O3+3C→2Al+3CO
And 2 Al2O3+3C→4Al+3CO2

In reality, much more CO2 is formed at the anode than CO:
Cryolite (Na3AlF6) lowers the melting point of the mixture and make it more conductive in nature so as to carry out electrolysis of the ore in Hall-Heroult process.
